clue.text: Brilliant red love bird

parts.note: flaming describes a vivid, fiery red colour
love is zero in tennis scoring, written as the letter O

explanation.surface: A vivid scarlet lovebird catches the eye.
explanation.walkthrough: 'love bird' reads as one thing, a lovebird, but 'love' gives O and 'bird' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: This pink-red wading bird of lagoons is a species name, so it is an example of the defining word.

clue.text: Front of cafe possibly accommodating a large number

indicators.note: accommodating means housing, so the following pieces sit inside the rearranged letters
possibly means the letters of cafe may be arranged differently

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number

explanation.surface: A café front that seats a lot of customers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' turns CAFE into FACE, and 'accommodating' puts A and D inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The face of a building is its outward front.

clue.text: Stays for a group of outstanding singers

parts.note: waits are bands of carol singers who stand out in the street at Christmas

explanation.surface: Someone stays on to hear a choir of exceptional voices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outstanding' looks like praise, but means literally standing outside: WAITS are British street carol singers.
explanation.definitionFit: To remain until something arrives is to stay for it.

clue.text: 26 is of this much-liked shelter

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a tent is a canvas shelter

explanation.surface: A popular shelter is part of the plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 26 refers to the answer to 26 Across, DESIGN, which is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A purpose or aim is a design, as in 'by design'.

clue.text: A spirited relation!

parts.note: relation here means a telling or narrative, and spirited means full of spooks rather than lively; it seems to describe a lively relative

explanation.definitionFit: A tale about phantoms is a narration full of spirits.

clue.text: Take in with a sailor's eye

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor; the possessive adds S
orb is a poetic word for the eye

explanation.surface: A seaman's glance takes everything in.
explanation.definitionFit: To soak up or assimilate something is a direct synonym for taking it in.

clue.text: Sort of jocularity the elderly find hard to take?

definitions.meaning: light teasing banter is a kind of joking

definitions.text: the elderly find hard to take?
definitions.meaning: split into three words, it describes being poor in years, which old people suffer

explanation.definitionFit: Playful banter is a kind of jocular talk, and split as bad in age it describes the infirmity of the old.

clue.text: Ignore superior air

parts.note: over means above or superior
an air is a look or appearance

explanation.surface: Someone snubs another with a haughty manner.
explanation.definitionFit: To neglect or fail to notice is to ignore.

clue.text: Go mounted on the fin est horse

parts.note: best means finest; the newspaper text splits the word in two
to ride is to horse, travel on horseback

explanation.surface: Someone rides the best horse in the stable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fin est' is the printed text's split of 'finest'.
explanation.definitionFit: To sit astride something such as a saddle is to go mounted on it.

clue.text: The company make believe no-one backs compulsion

parts.note: to act is to pretend or make believe

indicators.note: backs here means goes backwards, so the letters of no-one are read in reverse

parts.note: no plus one, the one written as the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A business pretends nobody supports its policy of coercion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no-one backs' looks like 'nobody supports', but it is NO + I (one) turned round to give ION.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means force or coercion applied jointly, which is compulsion.

clue.text: Dreads writhing snakes

indicators.note: writhing means twisting about, so the letters of the word dreads are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone dreads snakes as they writhe.
explanation.definitionFit: These are vipers, a family of venomous serpents, so they are snakes.

clue.text: Let off school in time

indicators.note: in means the school's name is placed inside the word for time

parts.note: a date is a point in time
Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: Pupils are let off school on time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Let off school' looks like a holiday; 'Let off' is the definition, as in setting off a bomb. ETON is a well-known English boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: To set off an explosive is to let it off.

clue.text: A fisherman's standpoint by the river

parts.note: an angle is a point of view or standpoint

explanation.surface: An angler sees things from the riverbank.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who fishes with rod and line is a synonym for a fisherman.

clue.text: Look over returning craft set for smuggling

parts.note: to con is to study or examine closely

indicators.note: returning means turning back, so the word for craft runs backwards

parts.note: art is skill or craft
a band is a group or set

explanation.surface: Inspecting a boat brought back and fitted out for smuggling.
explanation.definitionFit: Smuggled goods or illicit trade are goods meant for smuggling.

clue.text: Having a good grasp of defence?

definitions.meaning: read as two words, a ... is a firm grip
a fortress or fortified position is a defence

explanation.definitionFit: A fortress is a place of defence, and a firm grip is literally a powerful hold.

clue.text: A moulded dessert may be insisted on

indicators.note: moulded means shaped, so the letters of dessert are reshaped

explanation.surface: Someone insists on a moulded pudding.
explanation.definitionFit: To declare firmly is to insist on something.

clue.text: Greek fighter of some eminence among experts

indicators.note: among means placed within, so the eminence goes inside the word for experts

parts.note: aces are experts
a hill is a rise in the ground, an eminence

explanation.surface: A Greek warrior of high standing among professionals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eminence' suggests fame, but here it means a raised piece of ground.
explanation.definitionFit: The hero of the Trojan War in Homer's Iliad was a famous Greek warrior.

clue.text: Investing-limit not as yet settled

parts.note: an end is a limit
a debt owing is not yet paid

explanation.surface: An investment cap is still undecided.
explanation.definitionFit: To endow is to give funds, so it means investing.

clue.text: The instant estimate is "Could be better"

parts.note: a second is an instant
to rate is to estimate or assess

explanation.surface: A quick appraisal concludes that there is room for improvement.
explanation.definitionFit: Something mediocre or inferior is a thing that could be better.

clue.text: In-filling can give scholars muscular trouble

parts.note: MAs, Masters of Arts, are graduate scholars
a tic is an involuntary muscle twitch

explanation.surface: Filling cavities can give academics muscle spasms.
explanation.definitionFit: A putty or resin sealant is a filler, used to fill gaps.

clue.text: A tap — note cute con, struction

parts.note: fa is the fourth note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: construction means building something up, so the letters of cute are put together anew

explanation.surface: A tap's design looks sweet and well made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'con, struction' is the printed text's split of 'construction'.
explanation.definitionFit: A faucet is the American word for a water tap.

clue.text: Facing change around without point

indicators.note: without means outside, so the word for change surrounds the point

parts.note: to veer around is to change direction
NE, north-east, is a compass point

explanation.surface: A turn about can be made without a point of view.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin decorative surface layer on wood is a facing.

clue.text: Role in play for a woman

indicators.note: play suggests loose movement, so the letters of role in are rearranged

explanation.surface: An actress is cast in a female part in a play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in play' reads as on stage, but 'play' is the anagram signal on ROLE IN.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a female first name, as in Jane Austen's Elinor Dashwood, so it names a woman.

clue.text: Hard-top vehicle quickly produced

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
apace is an old word meaning quickly

explanation.surface: A hard-top car is made in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hard-top' looks like a type of car; it is the definition, the hard upper shell of a crab or tortoise.
explanation.definitionFit: A shell on the back of a turtle or crab is a hard covering on top.

clue.text: It's almost incredible in a European city

parts.note: a tall story is one that is barely believable

explanation.surface: Something nearly unbelievable is happening in a city in Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: TALLIN is an older spelling of the Estonian capital, now usually written with two Ns.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Estonian capital on the Baltic coast, so it is a city in Europe.

clue.text: A piece of journalism on soft grain

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means placed after, so the journalism follows the soft letter

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for soft
an article is a piece written for a newspaper

explanation.surface: A newspaper feature about soft cereal.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny speck of matter, like a grain of sand, is this.

clue.text: Condescend to accept small drawing

indicators.note: accept means take in, so the abbreviation is held inside the word for condescend

parts.note: to deign is to condescend to do something
S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: A grand artist lowers themselves to take a modest sketch.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan or sketch on paper is a drawing.

clue.text: Making up to a crude instructor

indicators.note: making up means composing or constructing, so the letters of to a crude are assembled anew

explanation.surface: Someone flatters a vulgar teacher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Making up to' reads as flattering, but 'Making up' signals the anagram of TO A CRUDE.
explanation.definitionFit: A teacher or tutor is an instructor.
